nodes.name: Resolve Silo Category ID
nodes.notes: FIX: WordPress REST API requires numeric category term IDs, not slugs. This resolves the silo slug to its ID once per run, in parallel with research, so it's ready by the time we create the post. Uses the WordPress Basic Auth credential.

nodes.name: Resolve Life Stage Term ID
nodes.notes: Life stage is a custom taxonomy (non-hierarchical, show_in_rest, rest_base 'life_stage'); WordPress REST needs term IDs, not slugs - same bug class as the original category fix. Resolves puppy/adult/senior once per run, in parallel with the silo lookup, so Create Draft can attach both taxonomies.

nodes.name: Fetch Product Database (Google Sheet CSV)
nodes.notes: Replace with a published-to-web CSV URL from your product tracking sheet (product-data/product-database.schema.md). Returns raw CSV text - the Parse Product CSV node turns it into rows.

nodes.name: Parse Product CSV
nodes.notes: FIX: the published Google Sheet CSV arrives as raw text, not an array. Strips a possible BOM, parses quoted CSV rows, and keeps only status=approved && enabled=true products. Columns match product-data/product-database.schema.md.

nodes.name: Merge - Products + Sections
nodes.notes: FIX: explicit Merge so the product rows and the written sections arrive as one item carrying both section_html and products - no implicit branch references.

nodes.name: Insert Real Affiliate Products
nodes.notes: FIX: now consumes the parsed product array from the explicit Merge node instead of calling .filter() on a plain CSV string. Still never guesses - unmatched placeholders become a visible comment and trip the QA gate.

nodes.name: Generate SEO Title + Meta Description
nodes.notes: FIX: this node was missing before - the Yoast fields had nothing real to write. Runs only after QA passes.

nodes.name: WordPress - Create Draft (category + life_stage + Yoast meta)
nodes.notes: HTTP Request instead of the built-in WordPress node (v6): that node cannot express custom taxonomies. WordPress REST accepts life_stage as a numeric term-ID array via the taxonomy's REST base ('life_stage'). Sends category + life_stage + Yoast meta in one call; body mirrors runbook Section 11.

nodes.name: WordPress - Upload + Attach Image
nodes.notes: FIX-OPEN (Phase 10): image generation is not wired here - see docs/image-pipeline.md for the full plan (Gemini generateContent -> base64 decode -> media upload -> alt/caption PATCH, safe-image prompt rules). This node is intentionally a leaf so the draft + alert still flow; the Telegram alert tells the human the image is missing.
